text:
maya: Heads-up folks  microburst on 4th Ave at 7:20, had to dodge a waterfall from a delivery truck. Added 30m to my commute. Anyone else getting drenched?

derek: Oof. I got splashed but the worse part was the slow crawl on 280 northbound. Exited at Middlefield and took side streets. :umbrella:

sylvie: BART had a short delay at Daly City for a signal issue but crews cleared it; still packed though.

paul: Took the ferry in  calm sea, very wet sidewalk to the terminal. FYI if you walk from the Embarcadero lot, the temporary ramp is a slip hazard right now.

tranit-bot: Transit alert: Caltrain 8:05 from San Jose is running +10. BART: single tracking cleared at 07:50. Muni: expect crowding on N-Judah and 22 lines.

maya: thank you transit-bot. Also office note  the gray umbrella tote in reception has 3 spares and a big microfiber towel. Please return towels to the pantry after using.

lyla: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/rainy-day-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI (mood)

derek: Quick poll: if your shoes get soaked what's your go-to? react please: :shoe: change shoes, :tshirt: dry at desk, :socks: borrow extras, :umbrella: carry a spare

sylvie: :socks:

paul: :umbrella: (I keep a foldable in my backpack)

maya: anyone tried the new BART app realtime ETA? it seems slightly more accurate during today's weird stop-and-go.

tranit-bot: Note: app-based ETA feed is experimental and may be delayed by up to 90s during disruptions. Use official advisories for critical trips.

lyla: pro tip: if you commute from the peninsula, consider taking an earlier Caltrain tomorrow to avoid the expected evening storm surge. forecast shows another wave around 5pm.

maya: thanks! I'll shift my call. Also leaving a sign on the umbrella tote: "Redwood folks only"  don't want office neighbors walking off with the stash again.

derek: If anyone needs a lift from 3rd & King after 6, I can swing by, Im heading out that way.

maya: really appreciate it derek. stay safe out there everyone.
